answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via Proof-of-Space-Time audits over key-bound Merkle graphs. Each agent stores unique incompressible blocks and answers random leaf challenges during the zenith of network demand using compact falcon signatures. Tight millisecond deadlines bar fetching from glacier cold storage, forcing attackers to dedicate local NVMe capacity per identity. However, adversaries with GPUs can still use time-memory trade-offs to recompute pruned graph layers.
